rationale: Story Studio contains bounded advisory choice points such as comparing user-created narrative branches or resolving ambiguous production-profile mappings. Decision Fabric may advise only within an already permitted candidate set. Authorship, edit acceptance, branch promotion, final screenplay state and final publication remain explicit human-controlled operations.

decision_points.purpose: compare or rank already existing user-created narrative alternatives using declared project criteria without creating or deleting branches
surface candidate mappings when a source story element has multiple valid representations in the selected target Production Profile
decision_points.candidate_source: FA3-STORY-STUDIO-001 Production Profile Registry deterministic compatible mappings

not_delegated: creation of new narrative alternatives without user intent
acceptance or rejection of collaborative edits
candidate-set expansion outside deterministic Story Studio rules
